The '''governor's palace''' on [[Begeren]] was a massive structure built to house the [[Unidentified Advozse Governor|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the [[Invasion of Begeren]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]] infiltrated the [[palace]] and [[Death/Legends|executed]] the [[Governor/Legends|governor]].
